title: Cognitive Electrophysiology in Socioeconomic Context in Adulthood: An EEG dataset
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 127 young adults (18-30 years) together with retrospective indicators of childhood family socioeconomic status (SES) and adult SES measures, including education, income, food security, and home and neighborhood characteristics. EEG was recorded during ERP CORE tasks or adaptations of them, which target perception, cognition, and action. The dataset also includes an adult ADHD symptoms checklist, so that links between SES, ADHD symptoms, and neural activity can be examined in a socioeconomically diverse sample.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Brain Products actiCHamp Plus system and BrainVision Recorder, using a 32-channel actiCAP slim active electrode cap. Twenty-seven channels were scalp electrodes placed per the 10/20 system, two were mastoid references, and three were EOG electrodes. Data were sampled at 500 Hz with a Cz reference and an FPz ground. StimTrak measured a stimulus presentation delay of about 20 ms for both visual and auditory stimuli.
